grade.summary: The complete solution set is correct, and both main cases are handled coherently. The omitted step is load-bearing for the bijectivity argument but requires only one direct substitution. Some restrictions involving division by \(c-a\) and the definition of \(g(c)\) are also stated imprecisely, though the final argument uses only admissible values.
strengths: Correctly derives bijectivity and identifies \(f(x)=-x\) in the \(f(0)=0\), nonzero case.
Verifies the zero function and gives the complete correct answer family.

errors.description: The existence of \(a\ne0\) with \(f(f(a))\ne0\) is asserted without the necessary one-line application of \(P(a,0)\).
Several identities involving \(C_a\), division by \(c-a\), and periodicity of \(g\) omit the exclusions \(a\notin\{0,c\}\), although the decisive final substitution respects them.
